 >> I  shy  away  from  things  that  I  can't 
 define.  I  function  100%  in  the 
 observable  reality.  When  someone  says, 
 "I  have  manifested  this,"  I  would  say, 
 "If  you  have  a  set  of  beliefs  that  you 
 repeat  it  on  a  regular  basis,  that  then 
 changed  your  behavior,  the  behavior  is 
 what  created  this  outcome, 
 not  what  you  repeat  to  yourself.  As  long 
 as  whatever  you  do  translates  into
